notes.title: Temporary fix for English language
notes.notes:
In case you are using non-English system, but want to read English text,
we prepared a test version that set default langage to English.
(This fix is applied for non Japanese or simplified Chinese system)

Choose "test" build in the Beta tab of the game property, and close the window.
(No code required)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475291/f5ca0ad33180bd103d22f281da126b295568fb47.png[/img]

Then the beta program(build ID:1392339) will be applied after a while.

This is a temporary fix.
Now we are working to add language option in the game.

Thank you.
